text.p: The following are the reports carried by Estonia's newspapers on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these reports and does not vouch for their accuracy:

- The European Commission announced its decision to include Estonia in the first round of entry negotiations. President Lennart Meri said Estonia understands both the rights and responsibilities involved.
- The energy council rejected a plan to form a company in eastern Estonia called Narva Power Stations.
- The dismissed head of the Tallinn police accusses Interior Minister Robert Lepikson of incompetence.
- Seif Sharif Hamadi, leader of the liberation movement in Zanzibar, was elected as new chairman of the Unrepresented Nations Organisation.
- Opposition party Pro Patria is planning to launch a no-confidence vote against Lepikson.
